name: @0xnothing/0xpump-subgraph-mainnet
description: 0xPump Goldsky subgraph overlay for LitVM mainnet

scripts.codegen: npm run configure && graph codegen subgraph.yaml
scripts.build: npm run configure && graph build subgraph.yaml
scripts.check: npm run codegen && npm run build && npm run test:compile
scripts.deploy: npm run deploy:check && npm run build && goldsky subgraph deploy zeroxpump-mainnet/1.0.0 --path . --tag prod
